data.name: TabsDescription
data.value: A strip of tabs bound to a key: icons, a counter in a title, a disabled tab, a strip that scrolls when it overflows, and a settings page in tabs with a danger zone.

data.name: TabsOverflowTitle
data.value: A strip wider than its box

data.name: TabsDocumentCountDescription
data.value: The counter shown in the Documents tab.

data.name: TabsDisableArchiveDescription
data.value: The last tab can no longer be chosen with the mouse or the keyboard.

data.name: TabsShowCountersDescription
data.value: A badge in the title of the Documents and History tabs.

data.name: TabsSelectedDescription
data.value: Drives the same value as the strip, even towards a disabled tab.

data.name: TabsSettingsExampleNote
data.value: One icon tab per topic, one section per tab, one tile per setting. A switch in a tile takes the name of the tile as its label, and a click on the tile toggles it. The last tab holds a danger zone whose actions ask first.

data.name: TabsSettingsDescription
data.value: These tabs keep their state in the page: unlike tabs bound to the address, they do not change it.

data.name: BreadcrumbsNewTabDescription
data.value: The links of the list open in a new tab, with rel="noopener noreferrer".

data.name: BreadcrumbsUnlinkedStepDescription
data.value: The Navigation level loses its address and is written as text.

data.name: BreadcrumbsMarkCurrentDescription
data.value: The last level shown becomes plain text, announced as the current page.

data.name: BreadcrumbsDepthDescription
data.value: Number of levels shown in the trail.

data.name: BreadcrumbsDescription
data.value: Breadcrumb trail and links: current page, step without a link, same tab or new tab.

data.name: BreadcrumbsSettingsDescription
data.value: The links all point to pages of this gallery.

data.name: StepsDescription
data.value: Steps of a process: current step, guard on navigation, disabled step, previous and next buttons.

data.name: StepsLockAheadDescription
data.value: A click can go back or to the next step, never further.

data.name: StepsDisableReviewDescription
data.value: The second step can no longer be clicked.

data.name: StepsSettingsDescription
data.value: The buttons set the step directly; clicking a step goes through the guard.

data.name: ProfileMenuDisableAdminDescription
data.value: The entry stays visible but can no longer be chosen.

data.name: ProfileMenuShowLinkDescription
data.value: An entry with an address is rendered as a link rather than a button.

data.name: ProfileMenuDisabledDescription
data.value: The trigger is inactive: the menu does not open.

data.name: ProfileMenuCloseOutsideDescription
data.value: A click elsewhere on the page closes the menu; a click in these settings does not count.

data.name: ProfileMenuCompactDescription
data.value: Tightens the controls and the spacing of the menu.

data.name: ProfileMenuDescription
data.value: Account menu: a summary or an avatar that opens a list of links and actions, one of which can be disabled, under an optional identity header.

data.name: ProfileMenuSettingsDescription
data.value: The last entry chosen is echoed under the menu.

data.name: AppMenuFlagsDescription
data.value: The flag of the language in force beside the list.

data.name: AppMenuLanguagesDescription
data.value: Three languages offered: the Language row shows from two on.

data.name: AppMenuAccountDescription
data.value: The user’s name on the button and at the top of the menu, with their role.

data.name: AppMenuDescription
data.value: The standard menu at the end of the app bar, the same in every application: account, language, mode, theme, settings, version and sign out. A row only shows when the application gives it what it needs.

data.name: AppMenuSignOutDescription
data.value: The sign-out button at the foot of the menu, beside the version.

data.name: AppMenuSettingsRowDescription
data.value: The row that leads to the application’s settings.

data.name: AppMenuSettingsDescription
data.value: The mode and the theme are always there; the other rows follow what the application provides.
